checks.text: The page displays the heading "Dynamic Form Builder" and a list area that initially contains the text "No forms yet".
Typing "Contact Us" in the field labelled "Form name" and clicking the button "Create form" adds a list item containing "Contact Us" and removes the text "No forms yet".

Clicking the button "Edit" on the "Contact Us" list item opens a form designer view. Typing "Email" in the field labelled "Label", selecting "text" in the select labelled "Type", checking the checkbox labelled "Required", and clicking the button "Add field" adds a row to the field list containing "Email" and "text".
In the field list for "Contact Us", clicking the button "Delete" next to the "Email" row removes that row from the list.

With the "Email" field present, clicking the button "Preview" switches to a fill view. Leaving the field labelled "Email" empty and clicking the button "Submit" displays the error message "Email is required" and does not show a success message.

In the fill view for "Contact Us", typing "test@example.com" in the field labelled "Email" and clicking the button "Submit" displays the success message "Form submitted successfully" and hides the error message.
After a successful submission, clicking the button "Export JSON" copies a string to the clipboard that contains the key "email" and the value "test@example.com".
Clicking the button "Save form" in the designer view returns to the list view, and the list item for "Contact Us" now displays the text "1 field".
Reload keeps the form "Contact Us" in the list with the text "1 field" visible.
